dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Your footsteps told me you were coming, hehe!

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: That's how I knew to wait for you here!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: It's... It's all really nice! Don't worry about me. I can take care of myself.

choices.text: Sure you're not just putting on a brave face?

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Huh? No... of course not!

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: What gave you that impression though? Was it my ears? My... facial expression? Or my body language?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: All of the above, really.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: I'm sorry! It's just... It's a completely new environment, and my body's taking some time to adapt.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Thanks for your concern, but... I'll be fine. Really, I will.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Oh — the weather here's really great, and there's such a peaceful atmosphere. I love it!

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: I want to adjust as quickly as possible, and I also don't want you to worry about me, so...

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: ...Could I stay here for a little longer? I won't cause a fuss! You won't even know I'm here!

choices.text: You can relax a little more, you know.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: ...You're right. Thank you for inviting me here. I'll... I'll try my hardest to relax!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: If you're "trying," you're probably doing it wrong... Just... relax.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: O—Oh, yeah. Good point...

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: It's just... Your place is so nice, and your invitation made me so happy, I'm not sure what to do...

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: M—Maybe I just need a little more time to adjust.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: I... don't travel often, and here, I'm surrounded by things I've never seen before! I almost forget to breathe just trying to take it all in...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It's alright! You can do whatever you want here.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Ohh, thank you! *sniff* You're so nice...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Sure! I'm not the chattiest person in the world though — not like Mualani... I hope that's okay?

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Uh... but, um... yeah! I can just listen, mostly! Whatever you want to talk about, it's fine with me!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You really are the nervous type, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Uhh... Yeah, guilty as charged.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: I've failed so many times in the past, I'm constantly worried about messing things up again...

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: I wish I could get everything right... I mean, not like a hero, or anything. I just... really want to live up to people's expectations.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Oh! That reminds me, you've had a lot of amazing experiences...

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Do you ever get nervous? When you're in new place, or facing a new enemy?

choices.text: Of course I do. It's a perfectly normal response.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Wait. You too? I thought I only felt that way because I'm weak...

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: It's such a relief to hear you say that. I guess I've just been scaring myself silly all along, huh?

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Oh, or... maybe we're talking about different things. I mean, I get nervous-nervous, and maybe with you, you're just... anxious to appear modest?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Nah. Everyone gets nervous. Sometimes, you've just got to roll with it.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Roll with it... Hehe, that kinda makes sense! It's so simple when you put it like that.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: For me, being nervous is pretty much the default.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: But... I think I get what you mean. Maybe one day, I'll be able to be at peace with my nerves, just like you.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Whoops — this was supposed be a light-hearted chat, but it's ended up being another mentoring session... Sorry, this always happens, doesn't it...

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: If there's anything that I can do for you, please let me know!

choices.text: Not really. I'm used to it by now.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: I knew it! That's what makes you a real hero — staying calm, controlled, and rational whatever the situation.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: I guess I've just got to keep practicing so I get used to it too. Just like with my dancing!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That's right. One step at a time, at your own pace — just like dancing!

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Exactly! I just need to go on a few more adventures... and get a few more wins under my belt... and then I'm sure to be less nervous.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Would you mind taking me with you on some more adventures? Or... sharing some of your experiences with me in your spare time? I'll do my best to learn, and I'll definitely find some way to repay you!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything you want to do?

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Let me think. Hmm... Nope, nothing in particular.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: I'm quite content at the moment. In fact, it's more than that... I'm happy.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You sure you're not just putting on a brave face?

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Hehe, of course not! I doubt I could fool you, anyway — you know me too well by this point.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: I'm really enjoying my time here. Once I got used to it, I realized that your home's kind of like a dream world... the kind of thing you read about in storybooks.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: It's not just the beautiful scenery, either. I love all this open space! It's so much fun just riding around the place on Turbo Twirly.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: The pace of life here is so nice, too. I could stay here forever.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Glad to hear it.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Heh~ Once again, thank you so, so much for inviting me here... My family's always telling me, you can never thank someone too much!

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: By the way, would you like to visit my home sometime?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: N—Nothing... I just suddenly remembered all the piles of stuff in my room... I gotta take care of that before you come over.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: There's still a few boxes left under my bed... and my top shelves are empty... Yeah, that should do the trick.

choices.text: There's no need to tidy up for me.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Oh... Thanks, it's really nice of you to say that! I... feel a lot more confident now.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Relax, it'll be fine.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Hehe, so it's decided then? I'll have every stone in its proper place by the time you arrive!

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: And that's a promise! Even if it's crowded, it's still gotta look nice.

choices.text: A crowded house is a house with character.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Kachina.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Morning! Heading out on a new adventure?

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Could you bring me along today, too? There's still so much I wanna learn from you!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Kachina.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Nighty night! Before I go to sleep, I need to process everything that's happened today!

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: ...Hey, don't look at me like that! I didn't mean I'm gonna go cry in a corner again! Not this time, I promise.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Wow! Look at this stage you've built... it's perfect!

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Um... Heh, uh... I—I know a few dance moves, so... would you mind if I tested them out here?

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: ...Really? You actually wanna watch? That's great! I won't disappoint! ...At least, I hope I won't...

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: I only just noticed how orderly all this furniture is.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: It must have taken you ages, surely? I bet it was tiring... Feel free to ask me to help next time.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: I can't promise I'd be any use with other stuff. But sorting and organizing is my specialty, so I'd definitely make things better and not worse!
